question: How is immense material wealth contrasted with the value of this teaching?
premises: One might possess enough to fill the ocean with jewels
Such accumulation is presented as a comparison
inference: Even vast material wealth is incomparable to the value of this teaching
uncertainties: ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is a fused and unclear form
plain_english: Even if one had an accumulation enough to fill the ocean with jewels...
